originalTitle: Goldman Sachs (GS) Stock Sinks As Market Gains: What You Should Know
summary: In the latest trading session, Goldman Sachs (GS) closed at $1, marking a -1.81% move from the previous day.
content:
Goldman Sachs (GS) closed at $1,021.65 in the latest trading session, marking a -1.81% move from the prior day. This change lagged the S&P 500's daily gain of 0.21%. Meanwhile, the Dow gained 0.22%, and the Nasdaq, a tech-heavy index, added 0.16%.

The investment bank's stock has dropped by 4.15% in the past month, falling short of the Finance sector's gain of 1.78% and the S&P 500's gain of 3.25%.

The investment community will be paying close attention to the earnings performance of Goldman Sachs in its upcoming release. The company is expected to report EPS of $15.62, up 27.51% from the prior-year quarter. In the meantime, our current consensus estimate forecasts the revenue to be $17.04 billion, indicating a 12.19% growth compared to the corresponding quarter of the prior year.

In terms of the entire fiscal year, the Zacks Consensus Estimates predict earnings of $68.89 per share and a revenue of $69.56 billion, indicating changes of +34.24% and +19.35%, respectively, from the former year.

Investors might also notice recent changes to analyst estimates for Goldman Sachs. Recent revisions tend to reflect the latest near-term business trends. Hence, positive alterations in estimates signify analyst optimism regarding the business and profitability.

Empirical research indicates that these revisions in estimates have a direct correlation with impending stock price performance. To benefit from this, we have developed the Zacks Rank, a proprietary model which takes these estimate changes into account and provides an actionable rating system.

The Zacks Rank system, which varies between #1 (Strong Buy) and #5 (Strong Sell), carries an impressive track record of exceeding expectations, confirmed by external audits, with stocks at #1 delivering an average annual return of +25% since 1988. Over the past month, the Zacks Consensus EPS estimate has moved 1.94% higher. Goldman Sachs is currently a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy).

With respect to valuation, Goldman Sachs is currently being traded at a Forward P/E ratio of 15.1. Its industry sports an average Forward P/E of 15.09, so one might conclude that Goldman Sachs is trading at a premium comparatively.

Meanwhile, GS's PEG ratio is currently 1.05. The PEG ratio is akin to the commonly utilized P/E ratio, but this measure also incorporates the company's anticipated earnings growth rate. The Financial - Investment Bank industry currently had an average PEG ratio of 1.04 as of yesterday's close.

The Financial - Investment Bank industry is part of the Finance sector. Currently, this industry holds a Zacks Industry Rank of 42, positioning it in the top 18% of all 250+ industries.

The Zacks Industry Rank assesses the vigor of our specific industry groups by computing the average Zacks Rank of the individual stocks incorporated in the groups. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

Be sure to follow all of these stock-moving metrics, and many more, on Zacks.com.

chineseTitle: 高盛 (GS) 股票随着市场上涨而下跌：您应该知道什么
chineseSummary: 在最新的交易日中，高盛 (GS) 收于 1 美元，较前一交易日上涨 -1.81%。
chineseContent:
高盛 (GS) 在最近一个交易日收于 1,021.65 美元，较前一交易日上涨 -1.81%。这一变化落后于标准普尔 500 指数 0.21% 的日涨幅。与此同时，道指上涨 0.22%，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数上涨 0.16%。

该投行股价在过去一个月下跌了4.15%，低于金融板块1.78%的涨幅和标准普尔500指数3.25%的涨幅。

投资界将密切关注高盛即将发布的盈利表现。该公司预计每股收益为 15.62 美元，较上年同期增长 27.51%。与此同时，我们目前的共识预测收入为 170.4 亿美元，较去年同期增长 12.19%。

就整个财年而言，Zacks 一致预期预计每股收益为 68.89 美元，营收为 695.6 亿美元，较上年分别变化 +34.24% 和 +19.35%。

投资者可能还会注意到高盛分析师预测的最新变化。最近的修订往往反映最新的近期业务趋势。因此，预测的积极变化表明分析师对业务和盈利能力持乐观态度。

实证研究表明，这些预测的修正与即将到来的股价表现直接相关。为了从中受益，我们开发了 Zacks Rank，这是一种专有模型，它考虑了这些估计变化并提供了可行的评级系统。

Zacks Rank 系统介于#1（强力买入）和#5（强力卖出）之间，具有超出预期的令人印象深刻的记录，经外部审计证实，自 1988 年以来，排名第一的股票的平均年回报率为 +25%。在过去的一个月里，Zacks 共识 EPS 估计上升了 1.94%。高盛目前在 Zacks 排名第一（强力买入）。

就估值而言，高盛目前的远期市盈率为15.1。该行业的平均远期市盈率为 15.09，因此人们可能会得出结论，高盛的交易价格相对较高。

与此同时，高盛的PEG比率目前为1.05。 PEG比率类似于常用的市盈率，但该指标还考虑了公司的预期盈利增长率。截至昨天收盘，金融-投资银行行业目前的平均 PEG 率为 1.04。

金融-投资银行行业是金融行业的一部分。目前，该行业的 Zacks 行业排名为 42，在所有 250 多个行业中排名前 18%。

Zacks 行业排名通过计算特定行业组中个股的平均 Zacks 排名来评估我们特定行业组的活力。我们的研究表明，排名前 50% 的行业的表现比排名后一半的行业高出 2 比 1。
